name: sitemind-v2
description: SiteMind v2 — RAG AI chatbot builder: site scraping, realtime live-page answers, Jev/LLM intent detection, current-session semantic + episodic memory, custom Q&A. Lean FastAPI + Postgres/pgvector + React monolith.

seed_features.description: Register/login with JWT, dashboard, deep-link-safe routing, /api/health, docker compose + Makefile
steps: Register a new owner and log in via the UI
Dashboard shows empty state
Refresh on /bots/{id}/analytics stays on that page
GET /api/health returns 200
Playwright E2E test for this feature passes and writes verification/f01-platform-shell.json

seed_features.description: 7-step bot builder wizard that persists each step and never skips (website, crawl, documents, Q&A, live sources, personality, test & embed)
steps: Create a bot from the fixture site URL
Each wizard step persists and Back/Next never skip
Final step shows chat preview and embed snippet
Playwright E2E test for this feature passes and writes verification/f02-builder-wizard.json

seed_features.description: robots/sitemap/BFS discovery, httpx fetch, JS-render fallback, main-content extraction, heading-aware chunking, live crawl progress, recrawl
steps: Crawl progress reaches done with >= 8 pages indexed
JS-rendered page is indexed
/private/ (robots-disallowed) is not crawled
Playwright E2E test for this feature passes and writes verification/f03-site-scraper.json
Upload the allergen PDF
Ask about allergens
Answer cites the PDF
Playwright E2E test for this feature passes and writes verification/f04-documents.json

seed_features.description: pgvector + full-text hybrid retrieval with RRF, embedding providers voyage|local|hash
steps: Retrieval for 'Saturday hours' returns the hours page chunk first
Playwright E2E test for this feature passes and writes verification/f05-hybrid-retrieval.json

seed_features.description: Streaming SSE chat with numbered citations, anthropic|mock LLM providers, grounding rule
steps: Ask 'What time do you open on Saturday?'
Answer contains the Saturday hours
Citation links to the hours page
Playwright E2E test for this feature passes and writes verification/f06-chat-answering.json

seed_features.description: Authoritative custom Q&A: direct answer above threshold, else injected as authoritative context; CRUD + CSV
steps: Add gift card Q&A pair
Ask 'can I buy a gift card'
Answer is the owner's answer with source Custom Q&A
Playwright E2E test for this feature passes and writes verification/f07-custom-qna.json

seed_features.description: DecisionProvider jev|llm|mock, six intents + flags, deterministic routing, intent chip in UI
steps: Realtime question shows intent chip realtime
Smalltalk skips retrieval
Out-of-scope declines
Playwright E2E test for this feature passes and writes verification/f08-intent-detection.json

seed_features.description: Live sources: select, fetch with timeout + JS fallback, cache TTL, last-crawl fallback, live badge
steps: Mark /events as live
Change events page content
Ask about events this week
Answer includes new event with live badge, no recrawl
Playwright E2E test for this feature passes and writes verification/f09-realtime-live-pages.json

seed_features.description: Current-session semantic facts + episodic summaries, memory panel, memory inspector, expiry purge
steps: Say 'Hi, I'm Priya and we're a group of 4'
Memory panel shows name=Priya, party_size=4
Later answer uses both facts
New session knows neither
Playwright E2E test for this feature passes and writes verification/f10-session-memory.json

seed_features.description: Lead intent shows prefilled lead form; leads stored and listed in analytics
steps: Ask for a catering quote
Lead form appears prefilled
Submit adds row in Analytics > Leads
Playwright E2E test for this feature passes and writes verification/f11-lead-capture.json

seed_features.description: Confidence scoring + guardrail events (no_context, no_citation, low_confidence, out_of_scope) + Guardrails tab
steps: Ask 'Do you sell car insurance?'
Bot declines
Guardrail event listed
Playwright E2E test for this feature passes and writes verification/f12-guardrails.json

seed_features.description: Conversations, intents, confidence, unanswered questions with Add to Q&A, leads, live fetch stats
steps: Unanswered list contains the car insurance question
Add to Q&A creates a pair
Playwright E2E test for this feature passes and writes verification/f13-analytics.json

seed_features.description: widget.js launcher + iframe on any origin, public rate-limited chat API, allowed domains
steps: Load a plain HTML page on another origin with the snippet
Open launcher and ask AC3 question
Cited answer shown
Playwright E2E test for this feature passes and writes verification/f14-embed-widget.json

seed_features.description: Free/Pro/Business plans, server-enforced limits, usage meter, Stripe or mock checkout
steps: Free plan blocks second bot with upgrade link
Mock upgrade to Pro
Second bot creation succeeds
Playwright E2E test for this feature passes and writes verification/f15-billing-plans.json
